sections.title: Numbers and contact details
body: Pause between number groups and ask Stämmer det?
Vowel length distinguishes glas (drinking glass) and glass (ice cream).
Sju begins with a Swedish sj-sound; imitate audio rather than English sh.

examples.fi: Noll fyra noll, två tre, fyra fem sex sju.
examples.en: Zero four zero, two three, four five six seven.

sections.title: Numbers and clear dictation
body: Learn 0–10 and the tens tjugo, trettio, fyrtio, femtio and so on.
Compound numbers form one word: tjugofyra, trettiosex, nittioåtta.
Use mitt with ett telefonnummer and min with en adress.

assignment.title: Episode 4 mission: Numbers and contact details
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: Hear the audio twice and answer: Which digits begin the number?

READ: Read once for purpose and once for detail. Answer: What is the house number?

SPEAK: Dictate a fictional phone number and ask if it is correct. Try once without the model, then repeat more clearly.

WRITE: Write a contact card with name, number, and address. Check word order and spelling.

TRANSFER: Change the last digit and correct the listener.

RETURN: Say 24, 42, and three digits.
